pr_title: samples: Bluetooth: Add CAP AD for TMAP peripheral
pr_body:
The TMAP peripheral sample was missing the CAP announcement service data.

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/59687

issue_context.title: samples: Bluetooth: TMAP peripheral missing CAP service data
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/tree/main/samples/bluetooth/tmap_peripheral sample does not advertise CAP Acceptor service data, which is mandatory to be spec compliant. 

**To Reproduce**
N/A

**Expected behavior**
The sample should be spec compliant and advertise the CAP Acceptor service data as defined by CAP v1.0 table 8.1

**Impact**
None

**Logs and console output**
N/A

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Commit SHA or Version used: e216dcfc3d430a42bf71d97a5f60d8756d67ec7a

**Additional context**
N/A
